A1.justification: Both PDFs describe DUET-VLM and provide complete, readable main text and Appendices A–C. The equations, 15 tables and eight figures can be matched across versions, including relocated appendix figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original DUET-VLM image and video benchmark results, training-time measurements, ablations and sensitivity analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original DUET-VLM benchmark results, efficiency measurements and analyses. Retained experiments still constitute original empirical results.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same dominant-token selection, local residual clustering and text-guided hierarchical pruning. The new example calculating 482 dropped tokens illustrates the existing procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate POPE, SQA-Image, TextVQA, MME, GQA and SEED-Bench-Image, plus TGIF-QA, MSVD-QA and MSRVTT-QA. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains FastV, HiRED, FitPrune, PruMerge, SparseVLM, PyramidDrop and VisionZip. Comparator membership also remains unchanged within the Qwen, training, video and ablation comparisons, including Appendix B.

E3.justification: The model configurations, token budgets, evaluation metrics and pruning settings are unchanged. Both retain cluster width 4, the default layer configuration {16:0.5, 24:0}, and the Qwen-specific settings in Table 15. The new clustering example is illustrative, not a revised experimental setting.

E4.justification: Both retain the same clustering and text-selection ablations, pruning-depth and token-allocation sensitivity analyses, and attention heatmap case studies. The appendix camera heatmap is relocated and renumbered, not newly added.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Reporting remains based on point estimates and normalized benchmark averages.

E6.justification: Matched tables and figures retain their numerical results and qualitative findings. For example, Table 1 retains 99.0%, 98.1% and 95.4% relative average accuracy at 192, 128 and 64 tokens; Table 4 retains 100.8% and 97.6% for the two video budgets. Appendix results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The token definitions, attention-based selection equations and rank-and-drop formulation are unchanged. The added arithmetic example does not introduce a new mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about dual-stage compression, joint vision-language optimization and accuracy retention. Introductory rewrites do not change their scientific scope.

C2.justification: The explanations involving local structure, salient text guidance and late-layer visual redundancy remain unchanged. Both retain the same qualifications and future work concerning detailed runtime analysis, video training, longer videos and additional modalities.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 newly specifies that experiments ran on one node of the compute cluster; v1 mentioned the cluster and eight AMD Instinct MI325 GPUs without specifying the node count. This refines hardware disclosure without establishing a changed setup. Hyperparameter tables and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Both retain the same 36 cited works and position DUET-VLM as extending VisionZip-style merging and PyramidDrop-style pruning. Reference reflow and citation page-number updates do not change research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 tightens introductory prose, corrects grammar, clarifies the computational-cost explanation and adds the worked clustering example in Section 3.1.1. The section sequence and overall narrative remain intact. Appendix figure references are updated incompletely.

P2.justification: The author block and page layout are reformatted. The camera heatmap moves from v1 Figure 8 on page 15 to v2 Figure 6 on page 13; the two sensitivity plots become Figures 7–8. Table 15 is reformatted and repositioned. No figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: Clearer prose, the concrete clustering example and the single-node hardware disclosure modestly improve readability and documentation. Scientific evidence remains unchanged. Appendix renumbering introduces a small drawback: one sentence still compares Figures 6–7 although the relevant sensitivity plots are now Figures 7–8. Overall, the clarification gains support a limited improvement.
